author: mmarchegiani
body:
This pull request introduces a new particle gun class with a uniform eta distribution and minimum dR support, and refactors the codebase to improve modularity and maintainability. The main changes are the addition of the `FlatEtaRangeGunProducer` class, the extraction of `FlatRandomEGunProducer` into its own header, and related code cleanups.

### New Feature: FlatEtaRangeGunProducer

* Added a new class `FlatEtaRangeGunProducer` in `FlatEtaRangeGunProducer.cc`, which generates particles flat in eta, phi, and energy, with symmetric +/- eta coverage and optional minimum dR separation. This class supports configurable numbers of particles, shooting modes, and debug output. It also provides a static `fillDescriptions` method for parameter validation.

### Codebase Refactoring and Organization

* Extracted the `FlatRandomEGunProducer` class definition into a new header file, `FlatRandomEGunProducer.h`, improving code modularity and reusability.
* Updated `FlatRandomEGunProducer.cc` to include the new header and removed the in-source class definition, relying on the header instead. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-98ec0897bd78a68cad24b460f4529e3d15920291a90e144e6bde8b97beb59681R10) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-98ec0897bd78a68cad24b460f4529e3d15920291a90e144e6bde8b97beb59681L28-L41)

These changes improve the flexibility of the particle gun infrastructure.
title: New gun shooting particles with flat eta distribution in +z and -z emispheres
